messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: Ninth protocol. Command wants to test a complete separation. The creature will be moved outside your sensory range.

choices.label: I accept the separation to prove it can obey without me.
I refuse: the bond is still too unstable.
I ask for more time to observe what it anticipates.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: At ten meters from you, it panics. At fifteen meters, it stops moving. At twenty meters, your own hands begin to shake.

choices.label: I hold the line and let the protocol finish.
I turn the exercise into independence training.
I follow the mental image it sends during separation.

messages.speaker: Professor Chen
messages.text: We have reached the sensitive point: who decides its future, the laboratory, you, or the creature itself?

choices.label: Military protocol decides while the risk remains.
The bond decides: we need to learn together.
It decides, even if its answer escapes us.
